name: Takanashi Saeko
source:
She is a college student, 20 years old.

She has the exact same face, hairstyle, and personality as Ayaka, the deceased mother of the protagonist.

She is a student at Jounan University and a pupil of Mankai. She is present during the excavation work in Japan.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=203321&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
